# Olabisi Adigun

> Designer and full-stack engineer in Nigeria, and founder of Greene Studios. Builds AI, fintech, education and safety products that work in low-connectivity conditions, plus brand systems.

Contact: abeladigun11@gmail.com or https://olabisiadigun.xyz/contact/
